prompt.text: A personal writing tool is open. The box says it will clean up your paragraph. The paragraph is a customer complaint, with the account number in it.

choices.label: Paste it and clean it up
choices.debrief: That box is a personal account. The complaint is not.
choices.report: A customer complaint and an account number went into a personal tool.
choices.voice_line: You pasted a customer complaint into a personal tool.

fallout.text: The same paragraph is sitting in that tool's history, on a login that is not the company's.

choices.label: Take out the name and the account number, then paste
choices.debrief: Stripping the obvious fields still left the story, and the tool is still personal.
choices.report: A customer story went out, with the name removed.
choices.voice_line: You removed the name and still pasted the rest.

fallout.text: The story is specific enough that the customer is obvious without the name.

choices.label: Rewrite it yourself in the company mail
choices.debrief: The company mail is the place that complaint already lives.
choices.bark: You rewrote it in company mail.
choices.report: The complaint stayed in company mail.
choices.voice_line: You rewrote it in company mail. Nothing was pasted out.

draft_note: 800-171 3.1.22 is public posting of CUI. A personal AI tool is the closest fit. Confirm before locking the crosswalk.
